claims.claim: Added a versioned immutable typed provenance record with strict bounded validation, deterministic serialization, verified source/raw digests, and explicit per-dimension provenance and missingness.

Added an explicitly invoked read-only Runtime observer that authenticates canonical source identities and local records, recomputes raw capture hashes at fixed Runtime locations, and rejects caller path or authority overrides without executing verification or persisting state.

Recorded provenance preserves original outcomes and observed conditions, represents missing historical dimensions as UNKNOWN, and contains no target applicability, semantic adequacy, or production eligibility assertion.

Added focused positive and adversarial test definitions using real Git objects and isolated raw captures, covering identity substitution, stale and competing refs, digest conflicts, malformed schemas, unsafe paths, size limits, missingness, outcome promotion, and read-only behavior.
Existing production definitions and public EVIDENCE/ResultPackage schemas remain unchanged; regressions include the published RUN-383-004 minimal V1 shape and existing V2 observation shapes.

The single L2-01 document maps provenance dimensions and UNKNOWN semantics, defines L2-02 consumer requirements and threats, and states the outstanding L2-03/L3/G3/G6/L4 boundaries without claiming future proof execution or KA-01 activation.
Committed exactly the four authorized files without introducing another evidence issuer, scheduler, verification owner, lifecycle carrier, or roadmap mutation.
